interlocks.cause: Guard door not closed (ZS-3002 / X32 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits or immediately removes HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: E-stop chain not healthy (ES-0001 / X0 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits or immediately removes HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: Pallet not present in ST30 (ZS-3001 / X33 OFF)
interlocks.effect: Inhibits HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

interlocks.cause: HiPot result latched (PASS M310 ON or FAIL M311 ON)
interlocks.effect: Removes HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

steps.entry: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33 resets PASS/FAIL latches M310 and M311)
steps.exit: Pallet present in ST30 (ZS-3001 / X33), guard door closed (ZS-3002 / X32), and E-stop chain healthy (ES-0001 / X0)
steps.name: Idle

steps.entry: Pallet in ST30 (ZS-3001 / X33), guard door closed (ZS-3002 / X32), E-stop healthy (ES-0001 / X0), and no result latched (M310 and M311 OFF)
steps.exit: Tester reports PASS (HP-3003 / X30), tester reports FAIL (HP-3004 / X31), guard door opens, or E-stop lost
steps.name: HV Test Active

steps.entry: Tester PASS input (HP-3003 / X30) or FAIL input (HP-3004 / X31) latches M310 or M311
steps.exit: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33)
steps.name: Result Latched
